nodes.description: ERC20 token name string, set to PalantirCoin in the constructor.
ERC20 token symbol string, set to PTIR in the constructor.
ERC20 decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply, initialized in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of token holder address to token balance.
Nested allowance mapping owner => spender => amount.
Addition helper that requires the result to be greater or equal to the first operand.
Subtraction helper that requires the subtrahend to be less or equal to the minuend.
Multiplication helper that requires a == 0 or c / a == b.
Division helper that requires a strictly positive denominator.
Constructor: sets name/symbol/decimals/_totalSupply and credits the entire supply to msg.sender.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
Returns the balance of a token owner from the balances mapping.
Returns the remaining allowance of a spender for a token owner.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd.
Transfers tokens from an owner to a recipient and decrements the caller allowance using safeSub/safeAdd.
Caller-controlled address used as initial token holder, balance owner, allowance owner and spender.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply() with no SafeMath guard.
State update of balances[msg.sender] and balances[to] driven by caller supplied token amount.
State update of balances and allowed[from][msg.sender] driven by caller supplied arguments.
Spender address parameter of approve().
Token amount parameter of approve().
Recipient address parameter of transfer().
Token amount parameter of transfer().
Source owner address parameter of transferFrom().
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom().
Token amount parameter of transferFrom().
Token owner address parameter of balanceOf().
Token owner address parameter of allowance().
Spender address parameter of allowance().
First operand of safeAdd().
Second operand of safeAdd().
Local result variable c = a + b inside safeAdd().
Minuend parameter of safeSub().
Subtrahend parameter of safeSub().
Local result variable c = a - b inside safeSub().
First operand of safeMul().
Second operand of safeMul().
Local result variable c = a * b inside safeMul().
Numerator parameter of safeDiv().
Denominator parameter of safeDiv().
Local result variable c = a / b inside safeDiv().

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the token name state variable.
Constructor assigns the token symbol state variable.
Constructor assigns the decimals state variable.
Constructor initializes _totalSupply with the fixed initial supply.
Constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
Constructor uses caller controlled msg.sender as the initial token holder.
totalSupply() reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply() reads balances[address(0)] from the balances mapping.
totalSupply() performs an unchecked subtraction that can underflow, flowing into the unsafe operation node.
balanceOf() reads the balances mapping for the given owner.
allowance() reads the nested allowed mapping.
approve() writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] with the caller supplied amount.
approve() keys the allowance by the caller controlled msg.sender.
transfer() mutates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer() computes the new balances through safeSub/safeAdd and writes them in the unsafe operation node.
transfer() debits the caller controlled msg.sender balance.
transfer() uses the caller supplied recipient address to resolve which balance to credit.
transfer() uses the caller supplied token amount in the balance arithmetic.
The caller supplied token amount flows into the balance update operation.
transferFrom() mutates the balances mapping for owner and recipient.
transferFrom() mutates the nested allowed mapping for the caller.
transferFrom() decrements the allowance with safeSub and writes state in the unsafe operation node.
transferFrom() uses the caller supplied from address as the debited account.
transferFrom() uses the caller supplied to address as the credited account.
transferFrom() uses the caller supplied token amount in balance and allowance arithmetic.
transferFrom() uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
Spender parameter flows into the allowed mapping update in approve().
Tokens parameter flows into the allowance value in approve().
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf().
tokenOwner parameter indexes the outer allowed mapping in allowance().
spender parameter indexes the inner allowed mapping in allowance().
First operand a is used in the addition inside safeAdd().
Second operand b is used in the addition inside safeAdd().
Local c holds the safeAdd() result and is returned to the caller.
Minuend a is validated and used in the subtraction inside safeSub().
Subtrahend b is the value required to be <= a in safeSub().
Local c holds the safeSub() result and is returned to the caller.
First operand a is used in the multiplication inside safeMul().
Second operand b is used in the multiplication inside safeMul().
Local c holds the safeMul() result and is returned to the caller.
Numerator a is divided by b inside safeDiv().
Denominator b is required to be strictly positive inside safeDiv().
Local c holds the safeDiv() result and is returned to the caller.
transfer() calls safeAdd() when crediting the recipient balance.
transfer() calls safeSub() when debiting the sender balance.
transferFrom() calls safeSub() for balances and allowance decrement.
transferFrom() calls safeAdd() when crediting the recipient balance.

normalization_plan.reason: The spender parameter only exists to index the allowance written by approve(); merge it into the approve function node.
The tokens parameter only supplies the allowance value written by approve(); merge it into the approve function node.
The to parameter only selects the credited balance inside transfer(); merge it into the transfer function node.
The tokens parameter only supplies the transfer arithmetic input; merge it into the transfer function node.
The from parameter only selects the debited balance inside transferFrom(); merge it into the transferFrom function node.
The to parameter only selects the credited balance inside transferFrom(); merge it into the transferFrom function node.
The tokens parameter only supplies the transferFrom arithmetic input; merge it into the transferFrom function node.
The tokenOwner parameter is only the lookup key of balanceOf(); merge it into the balanceOf function node.
The tokenOwner parameter is only the outer lookup key of allowance(); merge it into the allowance function node.
The spender parameter is only the inner lookup key of allowance(); merge it into the allowance function node.
